biggest_catch: There is a $0 annual fee, so the 20,000-point bonus is yours to keep net — but if you already received a new-account bonus for this exact product within the last five years, you are ineligible, and only eligible net purchases count.
catches: Only pursue spending you already planned to do — never overspend just to chase a bonus; buying things to hit a threshold wipes out the bonus math and is how people lose money on this.
Previous or new cardmembers are ineligible if they received this product's new-account bonus within the last five years.
Only eligible net purchases count — returns and credits are netted out; non-purchase transactions are excluded.
You must be a U.S. resident, and your account must be open and in good standing when the bonus posts.
Applying triggers a hard credit inquiry, which can temporarily dip your credit score by a few points.
The card's variable APR (around 20%+) will erase the entire bonus in a month or two if you carry a balance — pay the full statement balance every month.
